name: workbench-complete
description: BUYaSOUL ONE SYSTEM - Complete self-contained workbench with GSK, OmniRoute, CPL, Soul Economy, and Workbench UI

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix workbench && npm install --prefix omniroute && npm install --prefix cpl && npm install --prefix soul-economy
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "npm run start:omniroute" "npm run start:gsk" "npm run start:cpl" "npm run start:workbench"
scripts.clean: rm -rf workbench/dist omniroute/.next omniroute/dist cpl/node_modules gsk/node_modules
scripts.fresh: npm run clean && npm run install:all

author: BUYaSOUL Team
